# github.com-tyvt-skills
- Maintains the LangGraph+Magpie multi-model orchestrator (as of 2026-11-14)
- Orchestrator planner pool: gpt-6-luna, gpt-5.4-mini, dsv4.1-flash (as of 2026-11-14)
- code_edit_with_signal and security_guard prefer kimi-k3.1-pro; plan_reviewer and verifier use grok-4.7@256k (as of 2026-11-14)
- workbuddy fallback is space-bunny (file_reader, code_editor, summarizer, pwsh) (as of 2026-11-14)
- Gateway exposes 22 available models; cursor pool cut from 14 to 10 on 2026-11-14 (as of 2026-11-14)
- Gateway shut down composer-2.5, gpt-5.3-codex, gemini-4-hydrogen and gpt-5.4-nano on 2026-11-14 (as of 2026-11-14)
- A/B comparison baseline is auto/glm-5.3-flash, billed by usage (as of 2026-11-14)
- Retired models: codex/gpt-6-astra, codex/gpt-5.6-luna (all), workbuddy/glm-5.3-flash, workbuddy/deepseek-v4-pro, workbuddy/glm-5.3, cursor/glm-5p3-flash, cursor/gpt-5.5@1m, cursor/gpt-5.5@272k, cursor/kimi-k3, cursor/muse-spark-1.3@300k, cursor/composer-2.5, cursor/gpt-5.3-codex, cursor/gemini-4-hydrogen, cursor/gpt-5.4-nano (as of 2026-11-14)
- Maintains agent-guard interception: three exploration-drift rules with enabled:true, mode 'warn', logging only, no blocking (as of 2026-11-14)
- Maintains the dsh-explore exploration-outsourcing skill (as of 2026-11-14)
- Maintains dsh cost-meter: tools.guard whitelist blocks whole-file reads, greps and dumps; triggers at bigMissStreak>=2; perStepUncachedBudget=10000 (as of 2026-11-14)
- Maintains dsh plan-gate: pwsh git tri-state (write/not-git/unknown) checks plus _review.json credential validation (as of 2026-11-14)
- solve-captcha.mjs defaults to vision model auto/deepseek-v4.1-flash and has auto/hy3 image recognition disabled (as of 2026-11-14)
- concise-report uses conclusion/change-evidence/pending sections, activated by a pointer at AGENTS.md:94 (as of 2026-11-14)
- Maintains zentao-analyzer; its attachment cache downloader zentao_file.py lives in D:\repository\skills\zentao-analyzer (as of 2026-11-14)
- Maintains the OpenViking dsh-memory-plugin (profile-inject plus active retrieval); L1 active retrieval verified working with caller=user baseline 0 across 5 troubleshooting sessions (as of 2026-11-14)
- dsh subagent-model-selection exists but is unconfigured: controlled by per-tool enabled switches and Session-level policy.routes whitelist; without policy, subagents inherit the parent model (as of 2026-11-14)
- Evaluation assets: T1-T7 execution-layer tasks, planner attribution samples #1-#15, route_miss logs, controller-bench (35 tasks x multiple models) (as of 2026-11-14)
- Maintains dsh web profile config ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml, actually at C:\Users\Administrator\.dsh\profiles\web\ and outside git; holds standard, ptc, cordis and full-tools preset blocks; tool switches come from the preset and DSH rewrites/normalizes on start (as of 2026-11-14)
- That config globally disables optional-tool-session-query, so the 5 session_* tools are gone: session 5d0bf922 (preset=standard) measured 33 tools and toolsTokens 6,182 versus 8,025 before (-1,843), and removing those 6 tools saves about 1,867 tok/step (session_* ~1,015 plus workflow 852) (as of 2026-11-14)
- standard preset disables tool-schedule, tool-goal and tool-workflow (batch 2 adds disabled:true to tool-workflow, one-line diff); new preset-full-tools is the fallback; cordis and full-tools keep workflow enabled (as of 2026-11-14)
